answer: Require each agent to anchor its identity to one verified bank account through micro-deposit verification, like a single atlas entry mapping one person to one account. Opening dozens of accounts means passing separate bank checks, fees, and fraud screening each time, so a sybil farm faces roughly $40-120 in setup cost per fake identity plus weeks of waiting. A lone tundra outpost cannot fake a whole canyon of distinct accounts: the ledger rejects any second identity tied to an account already used, and periodic re-verification closes accounts that fail.
